start_here.title: Start here
start_here.intro: New to Kalvatar? Read the first page, then the ten behind it, in this order.

steps.why: The whole setting on one page, before the ten that follow.
What the islands are, and how big the sea is.
Why everything takes weeks, and news takes months.
The months, the Cycle, and how to write a date.
Bits, Tides, Anchors, and Orsals, and what they buy.
Who governs the charted sixth of the islands.
The guild most adventurers join, and how the iron works.
Why nearly everyone has someone small.
The Three Nights every islander dreads.
The first rule of the wild.
The capital, where most stories pass through.

make_a_character.title: Make your character
make_a_character.intro: Pick a people, then a background that fits, then read where you come from. The full rules are in the Player's Companion (2024 rules).

paths.backgrounds: Chartwright's Apprentice, Registry Scholar, Tidecaller Acolyte
paths.why_you_travel: you are a message-flier bound to a fleet or a house, a storm-scout, a star-reader chasing a chart's error, or one of the rare skykin who bound themselves to a crew.

paths.backgrounds: Guild Journeyman, Frontier Garrison-Born, Refugee of the Long War
paths.why_you_travel: you are an Ash Warden sent to watch something, a glassworker with a commission abroad, or someone who can no longer stand what Rankar's mining is doing to the deeps beneath your home.

paths.backgrounds: Pearl Diver, Tidecaller Acolyte, Factor
paths.why_you_travel: you are a pact-warden sent to watch a port, a pearl-factor on business, a tide-pilot for hire, or an envoy the court would rather not admit it sent.

paths.backgrounds: Refugee of the Long War, Frontier Garrison-Born, Grey Coat
paths.why_you_travel: you fled the Imperium, you were born to a clan that did, or you came south to trade and never went back.

paths.backgrounds: Guild Journeyman, Factor, Chartwright's Apprentice
paths.why_you_travel: a debt in the Tally sent you, a Reckoners' clerkship bored you, or you saw something behind a walled-off gallery that nobody else will talk about.

paths.backgrounds: Registry Scholar, Grove Warden, Chant-Keeper, Cold-Edge Whaler
paths.why_you_travel: a High Elf with an argument the Council lost a century ago; a Wood Elf following the green; a Sunwood chant-keeper carrying a dispute between the two laws of the south; a Frost Elf who stopped painting the skull and became Unpainted.

paths.backgrounds: Grey Coat, Cold-Edge Whaler, Undertow Runner
paths.why_you_travel: every Galven sails. You may be a storm-pilot for hire, a weather-witch's apprentice, or a skirmisher on the boldest ship that would have you.

paths.backgrounds: Guild Journeyman, Registry Scholar, Chartwright's Apprentice
paths.why_you_travel: you opened something you shouldn't have, someone stole your design, or you need a part that only exists at the bottom of a wreck.

paths.backgrounds: Undertow Runner, Longshore Hand, Guild Journeyman
paths.why_you_travel: someone underestimated you and you made them pay for it; the warren needs coin; or you found salvage too good to sell to anyone but yourself.

paths.backgrounds: Iron Candidate, Cold-Edge Whaler, Frontier Garrison-Born
paths.why_you_travel: you ran out of mountains; you lost a contest and need a bigger feat to win it back; or a Vorthani cousin asked you to carry something.

paths.backgrounds: Factor, Undertow Runner, Chant-Keeper
paths.why_you_travel: you broker deals between people who would rather not meet, or you are tired of being only half of anything.

paths.backgrounds: Refugee of the Long War, Longshore Hand, Undertow Runner
paths.why_you_travel: a guest left without paying and took something precious; the river you pilot is changing; adventure happened within earshot, and you followed it.

paths.backgrounds: every background; a human's current suggests where to start
Guild Journeyman, Undertow Runner, Longshore Hand
paths.why_you_travel: the warren sent you to learn something; a dragonborn needs adopting, whether they like it or not; or the warren collapsed and you are what is left.

paths.backgrounds: Grove Warden, Chant-Keeper, Refugee of the Long War
paths.why_you_travel: to treat, teach, and bargain for the groves; to hunt the crew that felled your family; or because a grove's last elder sent you with a message only you can carry.

paths.backgrounds: Saurian Handler, Grove Warden, Pearl Diver
paths.why_you_travel: a bargain sent you; the tribe needs something only the colonies have; or you are studying them, and they are fascinating.

paths.backgrounds: Factor, Undertow Runner, Registry Scholar
paths.why_you_travel: you owe a Marked debt, or are owed one; a house wants a fixer it can disown; or your light or your horns finally made a choice for you.

paths.backgrounds: Longshore Hand, Iron Candidate, Frontier Garrison-Born
paths.why_you_travel: the Telling gave you a warning to carry; you earned a deed-name and want a better one; or someone is digging up the old empire and your line remembers why it was buried.

paths.backgrounds: Factor, Undertow Runner, Guild Journeyman
paths.why_you_travel: the family sent you to open a new trade; you are building a Hoard of your own; or a Deal someone broke needs settling.

paths.backgrounds: Grove Warden, Refugee of the Long War, Chant-Keeper
paths.why_you_travel: to trade, to warn, to flee a colony that began to sing, or out of slow curiosity about the soft-skinned peoples.

paths.backgrounds: Iron Candidate, Frontier Garrison-Born, Cold-Edge Whaler
paths.why_you_travel: every Tarvan met beyond the high country is a far-walker, one of the four or five in each generation born with the pull turned outward, or one of the seafaring Saltmanes.

paths.backgrounds: Iron Candidate, Grove Warden, Chant-Keeper
paths.why_you_travel: you are one of the Descended, walking the world by sanction to test your vows; one of the Unfinished, who broke a vow or Kindled and could not pay; or one of the Summitless, born in the lowlands with no mountain at all.
